sloka: ते भित्त्वा बाणरूपाणि पञ्चशीर्षा इवोरगाः।श्वसन्तो विविशुर्भूमिं रावणप्रतिकूलिताः ।। ६.१००.३९ ।।
transliteration: te bhittvā bāṇarūpāṇi pañcaśīrṣā ivoragāḥ।śvasanto viviśurbhūmiṁ rāvaṇapratikūlitāḥ ।। 6.100.39 ।।

translations.english: The five headed serpent like arrows released by Rama penetrated and having been repelled by Ravana they entered the earth hissing.
